  MINUTES

  City of La Habra Heights
  Regular Meeting of the La Habra Heights Planning Commission
  January 28, 2014

Openina Ceremonies

Regular Business

1.  Call  Meeting  to Order — At 7: 00 p. m.  Chairman Black called the Regular
Planning Commission Meeting to order.

2.  Roll Call

Present: Chairman Larry Black, Commissioners Ray Fernandez, Greg Stefflre, Loren
R. Owen, and Alternate Eric Grimm.

Absent: Vice Chairman Dominick Dimario

Also  Present:  David  King, Planning Commission Attorney; Tabitha Lam, Interim
Planner;  Mary  P. Wright,  Interim Planning Contract Manager; and Sandra Studer,
Deputy City Clerk/ Records Manager

3.  Flag Salute

4.  Public Comment

Consent Calendar

Action: Moved ( Stefflre), seconded ( Grimm),  and  voted  5- 0 ( absent  DeMario) to
approve consent agenda items 5 and 6.

5.  Minutes Of November 12, 2013— Special Meeting

6.  Minutes Of December 17, 2013— Special Meeting

Regular Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  1  January 28, 2014

Approved March 25, 2014
 Action: Moved ( Grimm), seconded ( Steffire), to call for Planning Commissionreview of
project numbers 13- 104 and 13- 113 pending such time as there is a complete submittal
of the project to the City by the applicant.

Action: Moved ( Grimm), seconded ( Ross), and voted 5- 0 ( absent DiMario) to receive
and file the report for agenda item 7.

7.  Monthly Community Development Department Report

  End of Consent Calendar

Public Hearing

8.  Appeal Of A Planning Division Denial Of A Standards Modification To Allow
  The Addition To And Modification Of A Legal Nonconforming Single Family
  Residential Structure.
At 7: 27 p. m. it was noted that Commissioner Fernandez recused himself from
discussion of this agenda item and left the Council Chambers.

Action: Moved ( Black) and voted unanimously 4-0 ( absent DiMario and Fernandez) to
incorporate the language as suggested by the City Attorney into the motion of the
Planning Commission.

Action: Moved ( Grimm), seconded ( Steffire) and voted unanimously 4- 0 ( absent
DiMario and Fernandez) to grant the appeal and to direct staff to process a Standards
Modification Application given the conditions as recommended by City Attorney King
that the addition or modification does not increase the existing non-conformity and that
reasonable efforts have been made to decrease any pre-existing non- conformities.

At 8: 11 p. m. Commissioner Fernandez returned to his seat at the Council Chambers
table.

Administrative Items

9.  Resolution Recommending That The City Council Approve A Change In
  Planning Commission Meeting Commencement Times From 7: 00 P. M. TO
  6: 00 P. M.

Action: Moved ( Stefflre), seconded ( Fernandez) and voted 4- 1 with ( Grimm noted as
dissenting and Commissioner Demario noted as absent) to adopt Resolution No. 2014-
01 Requesting City Council Approval to Change Planning Commission Meeting
Commencement Times From 7: 00 P. M. to 6: 00 P. M.

10.  Discussion Of Definitions In Article 12 Of The Municipal Code

Regular Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  2  January 28, 2014

Approved March 25, 2014
 Action: Moved ( Grimm), seconded ( Fernandez), and voted unanimously 5- 0 ( with
Commissioner Demario noted as absent) to give members of the Planning Commission
and residents of the community until the May 2014 Planning Commission meeting to
either provide a list of definitions they are uncomfortable with or provide their
recommended changes to those definitions and then those
changes/additions/deletions/clarifications to definitions would be brought back by staff to
the Planning Commission at the July 2014 Planning Commission.
Staff Comments

Planning Commission Comments

Commissioner Fernandez requested and . Commissioner Grimm stated support for
placing an item on. a future agenda regarding story poles and when they are or are not
required and where the authorization or the legal requirement for installing them can be
found.

Adjourn Meeting —At 8: 45 p. m. Chairman Black adjourned the meeting.

Submitted for Planning Commission Approval
